annotations.text:
Flow: trainer signs in (1) and builds the session (2). In the room the projector shows the lobby (3); students scan the QR or type the code, then give name and email (4). Each question runs on its own timer set by complexity (5); the session clock caps the whole run. Scoreboard closes it (6).

Scoring: correct = 100, wrong = 0. Default timers: Easy 20 s, Medium 40 s, Hard 60 s. Both are editable per session.

Main direction (screens 1 to 6): warm paper for the trainer's desk, deep ink for anything on a projector or a phone in the room, one amber accent. Below are two different directions kept as sketches only. Say the word and I rebuild the six screens in either.
